verdict.rationale: Raygun documents deployment tracking through a Deployments API, which it says identifies new errors and regressions per deployment. It also records version on each error, lets users filter by version, and offers native GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab repo integrations. This covers the release-association core, but nothing shows issues displaying their first-seen release or naming a suspect commit. missing for 10: per-issue first-seen release display, suspect-commit attribution, commit-to-error linkage details, independent corroboration.
